summary: New Engineering Guide article: the 'lethal trifecta' prompt-injection risk in harness skills that ingest external content (untrusted content + sensitive/write access + outbound action), and the mitigation pattern (an explicit 'data, not instructions' rule wired into the actual ingestion point, plus naming any configured MCP connector as requiring the same per-action scrutiny as other guarded actions). Generalized from a project-specific doc describing the same risk in a discovery-engagement transcript-ingestion skill; file paths and skill-specific examples replaced with generic framing.
